text:
**Short answer:** For charging many cells at once, a 16-bay independent-slot charger is the best fit. If 8 bays is enough, the Tenergy TN480U is the one I can point you to with a price and a buy link.

## 16 bays (the most at once)
- **Tenergy TN438 16-Bay:** Takes any mix of AA and AAA NiMH/NiCd in any slot. It has an LCD showing each cell's status, protection against overcharge, overheating, short circuits and reverse polarity, and an 8-hour timer. ([source](https://electronicsadvisor.org/best-nimh-battery-charger/))
- **BONAI 16-Bay:** Slots are independent, so you can mix AA and AAA and load any slots. It runs on 110-240V AC at 250-500 mA per port, with LED status per port. It won't charge alkaline or lithium cells. ([source](https://electronicsadvisor.org/best-nimh-aa-battery-charger/))
- **POWEROWL 16-Bay:** Has 16 independent channels and a four-stage charge (pre-charge, quick, float, trickle). ([source](https://electronicsadvisor.org/best-aa-battery-chargers/))
- **CITYORK 16-Bay:** Has a smart LCD and ventilation for heat. ([source](https://electronicsadvisor.org/best-nimh-battery-charger/))

## 8 bays
- **Tenergy TN480U 8-Bay:** $23.99 at Tenergy's official US store. It charges AA or AAA mixed, at 500 mA per AA and 250 mA per AAA. It has a per-slot LCD, bad-cell detection, and USB-C or Micro-USB input. **[Buy the Tenergy TN480U](https://dealectric.com/go/tenergy-tn480u-8-bay-nimh-charger)** ([source](https://dealectric.com/answers/best-high-capacity-aa-aaa-nimh-battery-charger-8-bay-16-bay-independent-channels))
  - The power adapter isn't included. Use a 2 A USB-C charger, because on a 1 A source five or more AA cells drop to 250 mA each.
  - The source doesn't confirm that every bay is fully independent.
- **EBL 8-Bay:** Has independent slots, MCU safety control, and per-slot LEDs. ([source](https://electronicsadvisor.org/best-aa-aaa-charger/))

## Caveats
- The 16-bay picks come from affiliate-style roundup articles, not hands-on tests. Those articles only offered "Check Price on Amazon" buttons, so I can't give you verified direct links or current prices for the 16-bay models. Search the model name on Amazon or the maker's site.
- The Dealectric link is an affiliate link. It's also the only source that gave a price, and it had no 16-bay charger on record.
- If you buy the TN480U, two of them covers 16 cells for about $48 plus adapters.
- If you need new cells to go with it, Tenergy's 2,800 mAh AA 20-pack is $42.99. **[Tenergy Premium PRO AA 20-pack](https://dealectric.com/go/tenergy-premium-pro-aa-2800mah-20-pack)**

Tell me your budget and how many cells you usually charge, and I can narrow it down.
